scope: All historical data capture, across all agreed sectors and geographies
explicit_window_policy: Explicit date windows remain available for bounded cohorts, retries and existing checkpoints.

source_groups.sec: Shared historical CLI default implemented; filing-date windows.
source_groups.clinical_regulatory: Shared historical CLI default implemented for ClinicalTrials.gov, FDA, EMA, UK, Japan, ChiCTR and NMPA date-window cohorts. Source coverage limitations still apply.
source_groups.disclosures: Shared historical CLI default implemented for HKEX, documents, press releases, licensing, M&A and strategic transactions.
source_groups.patents: Shared historical CLIs, global query/backfill planning and scheduled global backfill start 2021-01-01.
source_groups.market_prices: 2021 target applies; legacy exact-date HKEX capture remains available, shared bulk migration pending.
source_groups.news: Shared historical CLI starts 2021-01-01; Marketaux sampled archive begins in 2021, Finlight recent-only access cannot supply the full history.
source_groups.people_conferences_social: 2021 target applies; legacy explicit date-window scripts remain available, shared bulk migration pending.
source_groups.company_listings_products_relationships: 2021 target applies to dated history; current EODHD profiles, registry evidence and entity snapshots are observed now, not backdated.
source_groups.nmpa_inventory: Current inventory is a baseline, not a 2021 snapshot; dated detail records use the historical target.
source_groups.patent_assignments: Retain complete source history as relationship evidence; the 2021 research target must not erase older ownership-chain evidence. Current observations are not backdated.

coverage_policy: Unavailable periods and undated records must remain explicit gaps; a configured start date is not proof of coverage.
execution_policy: Use bounded windows and existing quota/checkpoint controls; this policy does not reset daily origins or launch full backfills.
